'''Josh Smith''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 104 from Saint Joseph, MI.<ref name="sm-fan" /> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
